_doc: SEED-LIFECYCLE-1 answers for the Replication Ledger tenant. Safeguards map to instances/replication-ledger/runway.json; read by foundation/seedlife.py. Deployed as ultrastable-replication-ledger by deploy-ultrastable from its own repository, ultrastable/replication-ledger (TENANT-REPO-1, FULLSTACK-1).

budget.how: runway.json ai-cost: at most BEAT.READS model reads an hour on the free Workers AI allowance; standings are computed by standing.js

models.how: runway.json model-retired: when no model answers, the fixed lexical reader in discover.js files the attempt under the same verbatim-quote guard

health.how: the watchdog fetches the verify URL every pass once it is set

improvement.how: the weekly discovery beat is the next slice; until it lands new replications are filed with cli.mjs add

privacy.how: no accounts or cookies; the first slice serves read-only JSON and records nothing about readers
